item.text: {"action":"experiment","hypothesis":"A05 shows that routing cu_o and other to extra_trees/raw while letting fe_anion fall back to the global extra_trees/raw model is the best guard-eligible configuration so far. A01 indicates a separately fitted fe_anion extra_trees/raw expert degrades both pooled MAE and positive-Tc MAE relative to A05, suggesting that the small fe_anion partition benefits from a different inductive bias or broader fallback training. Using global hist_gradient_boosting/raw only for the omitted fe_anion route is a focused, previously untried test, while preserving A05's successful cu_o and other experts.","falsification":"Falsified as an eligible improvement if pooled weighted OOF MAE is not below 7.752598770753422 K, or if positive-Tc OOF MAE exceeds the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Subgroup changes, especially any positive-Tc or high-Tc deterioration, should also be acknowledged even if pooled MAE improves.","reason":"This isolates the only unresolved chemistry-route choice around A05: replacing the fe_anion fallback prediction with hist_gradient_boosting/raw while holding the successful cu_o and other routes fixed. It is more informative than changing targets broadly, since every observed log1p configuration strongly worsened positive/high-Tc error, and it avoids repeating A01/A04/A05.","revision_of":"A05","specification":{"input":"composition","routing":"chemistry","global":{"model":"hist_gradient_boosting","target":"raw"},"experts":[{"route":"cu_o","model":"extra_trees","target":"raw"},{"route":"other","model":"extra_trees","target":"raw"}]},"stop_reason":""}
